onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: Hear it. Keep it. Find it.
onboarding.benefitIdentify: Identify the music you hear, wherever you are
onboarding.benefitKeep: Save your discoveries, never lose them again
onboarding.benefitSync: Find them on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube
onboarding.legalNotice: By continuing, you agree to KEEP's Terms and Privacy Policy.

session.emptySubtitle: KEEP finds your music, files it, then takes you to listen.
session.waitingForMusic: KEEP is listening… no track detected yet.
session.endPromptTitle: The music seems to have stopped
session.endPromptBody: No new track detected for a while. End the session?
session.namePlaceholder: Name this moment (e.g. At Youcef's, Ibiza…)
session.chooseDestination: Choose where to file this track
session.emptySessionEnded: Session ended — no track detected, nothing to keep.
session.connectPromptBody: KEEP automatically saves your finds there and makes them visible on your profile — more visibility, more chances people discover your taste. You can do this later from Profile.
session.recognitionUnavailable: Recognition temporarily unavailable — KEEP keeps listening.
session.recognitionNeedsLogin: Sign in (Profile → Continue with email) to activate free recognition.
session.micPermissionDenied: Allow microphone access so KEEP can recognize music (browser or phone settings).
session.micSilence: KEEP isn't picking up enough sound — move the phone closer to the music or turn up the volume.
session.guestLimitTitle: Your {{limit}} free downloads are used up.
session.guestLimitBody: Create a free account and get {{bonus}} more downloads.
session.freeLimitTitle: Your free downloads are all used up.
session.freeLimitBody: Go Premium to keep downloading without limits.

history.title: My Sessions
history.empty: No sessions yet. Start your first KEEP session to begin your history of moments.

myMusic.title: My Music
myMusic.visibilityNotSynced: This track isn't synced with the server yet -- try again in a moment.
myMusic.visibilityFailed: Failed to update visibility -- try again.
myMusic.myKeepsEmpty: No track kept yet -- start a session and KEEP a track, it will show up here immediately.
myMusic.playlistsEmptyNoService: No service connected -- connect Spotify or Apple Music from Profile to see your real playlists here.
myMusic.playlistsEmpty: No playlist found on the connected service.
myMusic.albumsEmpty: No album yet -- appears once a kept track has a known album.
myMusic.requiresConnection: Connect a music service (Profile) to create a real playlist.

offers.title: Choose your KEEP plan
offers.sandboxBody: Real payment isn't connected yet on KEEP. This plan will be available soon.

profile.title: Profile
profile.createAccountPrompt: You're using KEEP as a guest. Create your free account to keep your music across all your devices.
profile.alreadyRegistered: Already have an account? Sign in
profile.guestExhaustedTitle: Your {{limit}} free downloads are used up
profile.guestExhaustedBody: Create your account and get {{bonus}} more downloads
profile.registeredExhaustedTitle: Your free downloads are all used up
profile.locationOptInHint: If enabled, users who also share public music and are near you can discover you in Discover and follow you. Disabled: nobody sees you by proximity. Never your exact position, never shared if you disable it.
profile.previewAsVisitor: View my profile as a visitor
profile.previewHint: Exactly what someone sees when opening your link or QR code.
profile.previewPrivate: Your profile is set to Private — a visitor would see nothing here. Turn on "Public profile" above to make it visible.
profile.photoPermissionDenied: Allow photo access in iPhone Settings to change your profile picture.
profile.usernameInvalid: Name can't be empty (50 characters max).
profile.musicServicesHint: Connect several services at once -- KEEP searches across all of them.
profile.compareNeedsData: Keep at least one track during a session to compute your music DNA.
profile.keepDnaHint: Computed only from your KEEP decisions — never from Spotify/Apple Music content.
profile.keepDnaEmpty: Keep tracks during your sessions to see your music DNA appear.
profile.recentlyPlayedEmpty: Connect Spotify to show your recent listens.
profile.recentlyPlayedNone: No recent listens found on Spotify.

discover.title: Discover
discover.noLocation: Enable location in your profile to see nearby profiles/events.
discover.emptyTrends: Keep some tracks to see your trends appear here.
discover.demoProfilesNote: Demo profiles — real discovery activates once real KEEP users are connected (see docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md).
discover.notConnectedYet: No real users connected yet -- Discover activates once the KEEP backend is wired up.
discover.upgradeToSeeArtists: 🔒 Upgrade to Premium to see other profiles' favorite artists.
